```yaml
name: Merge Queue Cleanup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'  # Run every 5 minutes

jobs:
  cleanup-merge-queue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Get list of unmergeable PRs
        id: get_unmergeable_prs
        run: |
          import requests
          response = requests.get('https://api.github.com/repos/nexi-lab/nexus/pulls?state=open&sort=created&direction=asc')
          prs = response.json()
          unmergeable_prs = [pr for pr in prs if pr['mergeable_state'] == 'unmergeable']
          print(f"::set-output name=unmergeable_prs::{','.join(str(pr['number']) for pr in unmergeable_prs)}")

      - name: Process each unmergeable PR
        if: steps.get_unmergeable_prs.outputs.unmergeable_prs != ''
        run: |
          import requests
          pr_numbers = steps.get_unmergeable_prs.outputs.unmergeable_prs.split(',')
          for pr_number in pr_numbers:
            pr_url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/nexi-lab/nexus/pulls/{pr_number}'
            response = requests.get(pr_url)
            pr_data = response.json()
            comments_url = pr_data['comments_url']
            body = "This pull request has been marked as `UNMERGEABLE`. Please rebase your changes and push again to update the status."
            requests.post(comments_url, json={'body': body})
            requests.patch(pr_url, json={'state': 'closed'})
```
